continuity: The Dark Heaven assault has crossed from the Outer Hall into the Inner Hall; nearly one hundred Tang Clan members, including Tang Jinhu, are dead, and the attack remains in progress.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord has defeated Tang Sadok's last counterattack, captured him, and is demanding the location of the Myriad-Poison Ring.
Only two members of the Tang Clan's former Ten Wonders remain alive after the Western Heaven Demon Lord kills one of the three survivors.
First Fiend has been ordered to fight Cheongpung and may kill him if he cannot be subdued; Cheongpung is actively resisting him.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord and the Blood Lord serve the same master, and the Blood Lord wants to personally kill Cheongpung, Jeok Cheongang, and Jin Taekyung.
Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung are being treated at the Tang Clan, and the Western Heaven Demon Lord intends to take them and Cheongpung alive if possible.
The Uninvited Guest Quest remains accepted with unknown parameters and death as its failure condition.
plot: Cheongpung arrives during the Western Heaven Demon Lord's confrontation with Tang Sadok, dodges the Demon Lord's eighth-stage Ghost Prison Finger, deflects his follow-up attack, and is recognized as Sword Saint Mae Jonghak's Disciple. He learns that the Blood Lord seeks to kill him, Jeok Cheongang, and Jin Taekyung personally, and unmistakable hostility appears in his normally clear eyes.

The Western Heaven Demon Lord defeats the counterattack by Tang Sadok and the three surviving members of the Tang Clan's Ten Wonders, killing one of them and capturing Tang Sadok. He orders First Fiend to handle Cheongpung, permitting his death if he cannot be subdued; First Fiend engages Cheongpung while the Demon Lord advances into the Inner Hall.

The Western Heaven Demon Lord walks through the blood-soaked Inner Hall with Tang Sadok restrained and tells him that the Tang Clan is collapsing before demanding the location of the Myriad-Poison Ring. First Fiend's assault has killed nearly a hundred Tang Clan members, including Tang Jinhu, and only two of the former Ten Wonders remain alive.

Preserve the 당문십기/당문삼기 homophone as Tang Clan's Ten Wonders/Tang Clan's Three Skills with an explanatory footnote.

open_questions: Can the Sichuan Tang Clan survive the assault?
Can Cheongpung survive First Fiend and change the battle's outcome?
Where is the Myriad-Poison Ring, and can it be secured before the Tang Clan falls?
What are the limits and nature of the Western Heaven Demon Lord's demonic martial art?
Will Jeok Cheongang recover before the siege exposes him to capture or further harm?

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, Jeok Cheongang's publicly acknowledged Disciple and the Fire Gate Clan's nineteenth successor, who obtained the Myriad-Poison Ring and remains in the Sichuan Tang Clan's underground prison while Jeok recovers.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, Jeok Cheongang's publicly acknowledged Disciple and the Fire Gate Clan's nineteenth successor, who obtained the Myriad-Poison Ring and is currently being treated at the Sichuan Tang Clan alongside his injured Master.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Young Peak master and Huashan outsider, grandson and Disciple of Sword Saint Mae Jonghak, and traveling companion of Jin Taekyung who is currently at the Sichuan Tang Clan after helping obtain the Myriad-Poison Ring.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Young Peak master and Huashan outsider, grandson and Disciple of Sword Saint Mae Jonghak, currently fighting First Fiend while defending Tang Sadok at the besieged Sichuan Tang Clan.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Mae Jonghak, the Sword Saint, is his grandfather and martial instructor; Cheongpung came to Huashan at about age three or four rather than being born there, lived with Mae Jonghak at a hidden residence, and secretly left Huashan without his grandfather's knowledge to challenge the Ten Dragons and Phoenixes; Baek Museong is his Martial Nephew through the current Huashan Sect Leader, met him ten years ago, and is now leading the effort to return him to Huashan; the current Huashan Sect Leader, the Heavenly Sword True Person, is his eldest Senior Brother by generation, has repeatedly tried to seize him and drag him back to Huashan, and has ordered him to return; Cheongpung never underwent Huashan's initiation ceremony and is technically an outsider; Li Feng is his Martial Nephew within Huashan's hierarchy; calls Jin Taekyung and Hyuk Mujin Benefactors after they feed him and is now accompanying Taekyung, Jeok Cheongang, and Hyuk Mujin to Sichuan to find the Divine Physician; he apologized to Baek Museong for beating Baek and the Three Plum Blossom Elites while escaping forced escort back to Huashan a year earlier.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** Mae Jonghak is his grandfather and martial instructor; Baek Museong is his Martial Nephew; Jin Taekyung and Hyuk Mujin are his Benefactors and companions; he now opposes the Blood Lord, the Western Heaven Demon Lord, and First Fiend while defending Tang Sadok.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Retired Supreme Peak master of the Sichuan Tang Clan, Head Elder, and head of the Council of Elders.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Retired Supreme Peak master of the Sichuan Tang Clan and former Head Elder and head of the Council of Elders; killed by First Fiend during the Dark Heaven assault.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan and son of Poison King Tang Taesang, currently gravely wounded after the Western Heaven Demon Lord killed most of the Tang Clan's Ten Wonders.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Current Family Head of the Sichuan Tang Clan and son of Poison King Tang Taesang, gravely wounded and held captive by the Western Heaven Demon Lord during the assault.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Middle-aged Western Heaven Demon Lord who infiltrated the Sichuan Tang Clan disguised as a Green Shadow Squad martial artist, uses an unexplained demonic martial art to alter his body and restore his lost left arm, and commands hundreds of black-robed hunters.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Middle-aged Western Heaven Demon Lord who infiltrated the Sichuan Tang Clan disguised as a Green Shadow Squad martial artist, commands hundreds of black-robed hunters, has captured Tang Sadok, and has ordered First Fiend to take Cheongpung alive if possible.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Leader of the Qilian Three Fiends and commander of the assault on the Sichuan Tang Clan.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Leader of the Qilian Three Fiends and commander of the Dark Heaven assault on the Sichuan Tang Clan; after killing Tang Jinhu, he is ordered to fight Cheongpung and may kill him if necessary.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Rendezvous contact to whom Han Su reports; accepted the Green Jade Buddha Staff, then killed Han Su after Han Su requested Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung's deaths; claims to be Jeok Cheongang's enemy and Hong Dao's killer.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Relationships:** He and the Western Heaven Demon Lord serve the same master; he now seeks to personally kill Cheongpung, Jeok Cheongang, and Jin Taekyung, while his former contact Han Su is dead.
